one_liner: Typed Python agent SDK with first-party durable engines and OTel-native observability.
best_for: Typed Python production agents with durable execution and OTel
when_not_to_use: Do not pick PydanticAI when the product is a React/Next streaming UI (use VS±MA), when the bottleneck is automatic prompt search (use DSPy as compiler), or when you need LangGraph-class arbitrary mid-graph interrupts without adopting a durable engine/Harness persistence.

api_primitives.hitl: Deferred tool calls / approval via durable engines + Harness; AG-UI tool approval interrupts
api_primitives.checkpoint: StepPersistence (Harness); TemporalDurability / DBOS / Prefect / Restate / Lambda / Airflow backends
api_primitives.stream: agent.run stream / StreamedRunResult; AG-UI and Vercel AI UI bridges
api_primitives.structured: Agent(..., output_type=Model); tool/native/prompted modes; Pydantic validation + retry
api_primitives.obs: Instrumentation capability; logfire.instrument_pydantic_ai(); plain OTel; Pydantic Evals
api_primitives.multiAgent: capabilities SubAgents / multi-agent guides; Pydantic Graph for typed control flow
api_primitives.mcp: capabilities=[MCP(url)] client; MCP API module; Logfire MCP in Harness
